body.subject: Host recovery reclaims a dead worker's worktree, proven by a real run

items.change: The coordinator records the host life it handed each recruited worktree out in: a new lives(worker, boot, repo) row written in the same transaction as the worker row, so no crash can leave a worktree with no life. The identity is read from BATON2_HOST_BOOT, else the Linux boot id file, else the Darwin boot time.
items.evidence: 6 recruit rows green, including the two host-recovery rows

items.change: Every invocation settles the host life before its command runs. A worker of an earlier life cannot have a live process after the host restart, so its worktree is removed with git worktree remove in the recorded repository, its branch stays, and its row stops naming a workspace. A registration whose directory is gone is pruned; a host that names no life reclaims nothing.
items.evidence: real run: recruit under host-life-1, then a run under host-life-2 prints 'reclaimed the worktree of worker w1: /private/tmp/bend2-recovery-proof.zxCdKn/repo/wt' on stderr, `git worktree list` then holds only the main tree, `git rev-parse --verify w1-branch` answers 0c7cf83dc078062b64cf17daa6c99b282ad98841, and `worktree w1` answers 'The worker has no recorded workspace.'

items.change: A dead worker's worktree holding uncommitted changes is retained: git refuses the removal, the refusal is reported on stderr, the worker row keeps naming the worktree, and nothing on disk is touched.
items.evidence: same real run: 'retained the worktree of worker w2: .../repo/wt2: git refused to remove it: fatal: ... contains modified or untracked files, use --force to delete it', wt2 still listed, partial.txt still reads 'uncommitted work in progress', and the lives row w2|host-life-1|/private/tmp/... remains

items.change: worktree ID answers that a reclaimed worker has no recorded workspace instead of reading a git status on an empty path.
items.evidence: 'The worker has no recorded workspace.' on exit 2 after the reclaim, asserted by the first host-recovery row

environmentRed: The deployment verification command (npm test --prefix impl = node impl/scripts/run-suite.mjs --all, the canonical whole suite) was not run by this seat: the root's standing instruction forbids a whole or near-whole suite outside swarm integrate, and this change touches only bend2/. The bend2 Python suite was run only for the three files that cover the changed paths: recruit.py (6), coordinator.py (16) and land.py (8), all green. bend2.scripts/run-checks.mjs was not run: neither .bend/bin/bend nor node_modules/.bend/bin/bend exists in this checkout and it would install a toolchain into the tree.

carriedForward: The reclaim fires when the host life changes. A worker whose process died without a host restart keeps its worktree, which is the retention the lane's failed-worker row pins (test_failed_worker_leaves_dirty_work_available).
push_git (896aec02) still has no caller: the coordinator has no publish verb.
The prune path (a registered worktree whose directory the host no longer has) is implemented and not exercised by a real run in this lane; the dirty-worktree refusal is the exercised refusal.
